abegg-bensira-msb: Martin G. Abegg Jr., transcription of the Cairo Genizah manuscript B of Ben Sira, folios XIII verso to XXI verso (Oxford, Bodleian Library MS. Heb. e. 62; Cambridge University Library T-S 16.314 and T-S 16.315), with the English translation by Abegg and Benjamin H. Parker, in Gary A. Rendsburg and Jacob Binstein, eds., The Book of Ben Sira (online edition of the Hebrew manuscripts with images, 2013), read 2026-10-31
reymond-masada-sirach: Eric D. Reymond, transcription of the Masada scroll of Ben Sira, column VII (Sirach 43:31–44:17), and his list of new readings in the Ben Sira manuscripts, in Gary A. Rendsburg and Jacob Binstein, eds., The Book of Ben Sira (online edition, 2013; new readings added 2020), read 2026-10-31
dssel-11qpsa-sirach: 11QPsalms-a (11Q5), columns XXI–XXII (Sirach 51:13–20, 30), transcription from The Dead Sea Scrolls Electronic Library (Brill), after James A. Sanders, DJD 4 (1965), as shown with the Ben Sira manuscripts by Rendsburg and Binstein, read 2026-10-31
rinkart-nun-danket: Martin Rinkart, "Nun danket alle Gott" (about 1636), English "Now Thank We All Our God" by Catherine Winkworth; tune published by Johann Crüger (1647), as described in the Wikipedia article "Now Thank We All Our God", read 2026-10-31
